workflow_name: Clang-tidy static analysis (Ubuntu 24.04, Python 3.12, Clang-18, Clang-tidy-18)
title: RISC-V clang-tidy build fails - artifact upload FinalizeArtifact returns 403 Forbidden
signature: Failed to FinalizeArtifact non-retryable error 403 Forbidden|Infrastructure
key_errors: Upload compile_commands step failed with conclusion=failure (job 90010364811)
Pattern match: FinalizeArtifact 403 Forbidden on GitHub artifact service - same as pattern 602c52a223d7ebfe
root_cause: The Build-riscv64 job's 'Upload compile_commands' step failed with a 403 Forbidden error when calling the GitHub artifact FinalizeArtifact API. This is a known transient infrastructure issue where the GitHub artifact service returns 403 (not a permission/auth issue, but a transient service error on GitHub's backend artifact storage). The upload-artifact action (ababushk/upload-artifact) treats this as a non-retryable error and fails the step. This in turn caused the downstream 'ci/gha_overall_status_clang_tidy' job to fail. A second attempt of Build-riscv64 (job 90018649932) was already in progress at investigation time.
reproduction_steps: N/A - transient GitHub infrastructure issue, not reproducible locally
recommended_actions: Wait for the in-progress retry (job 90018649932) to complete - it may succeed
If retry fails, re-add PR #37029 to the merge queue
Monitor GitHub Status page for artifact service issues
prevention_strategies: Consider setting if-no-files-found: 'ignore' in the upload step (already set) and wrapping the upload step with continue-on-error: true for non-critical artifacts. However compile_commands.json is needed for clang-tidy analysis, so this may not be viable.
historical_context: This is the second recorded occurrence of this pattern (602c52a223d7ebfe). First occurrence was 2026-07-17 on run 29591125373 / PR #36905. The error is a transient GitHub artifact service 403 Forbidden, not a code issue.
